title: ExploraTwin, a Non-Profit Research Platform for Digital Twin Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2608.20539v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Digital twin simulations show promise, but current empirical evidence suggests that the approach should be tested before being deployed in any particular context. To lower the friction for researchers and practitioners to test and deploy digital twin simulations, this brief commentary introduces ExploraTwin (https://exploratwin.org), an open-access, non-profit research platform for digital twin survey simulations. ExploraTwin supports two modes. In survey mode, researchers can upload a Qualtrics survey file or create a survey within the platform; select an available sample of digital twins; configure and run the simulation, and export analysis-ready data. In panel mode, researchers can assemble a small group of twins for open-ended conversations, document annotation, and moderated, focus-group-style voice discussions. translated_title: ExploraTwin，一个用于数字孪生模拟的非营利研究平台
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20539v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：数字孪生模拟显示出潜力，但当前的实证证据表明，在部署到任何特定情境之前，应对该方法进行测试。为了降低研究人员和实践者测试及部署数字孪生模拟的障碍，这篇简短评论介绍了ExploraTwin（https://exploratwin.org），一个开放获取、非营利的数字孪生调查模拟研究平台。ExploraTwin支持两种模式。在调查模式下，研究人员可以上传Qualtrics调查文件或在平台内创建调查；选择可用的数字孪生样本；配置并运行模拟，并导出可分析的数据。在面板模式下，研究人员可以组建一小群孪生进行开放式对话、文档标注以及主持的小组式语音讨论。我们还开发了CroissantTwin，这是一种用于向平台添加数字孪生样本的标准化数据格式。
tldr: 本文介绍了ExploraTwin，一个开放获取的非营利数字孪生模拟研究平台，支持调查和面板两种模式，并配套了标准化数据格式CroissantTwin，旨在降低数字孪生模拟测试与部署的门槛。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ExploraTwin, an open-access, non-profit research platform for digital twin simulations supporting survey and panel modes, along with the standardized CroissantTwin data format, to lower the barrier for testing and deploying digital twin simulations.
